scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run cf:migrate:local && concurrently -k -n WEB,WORKER -c cyan,yellow "npm:dev:web:watch" "npm:dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run check:worker
scripts.verify:release: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:artifacts && npm run audit:production
scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply qwen-image-3-production --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply qwen-image-3-production --remote --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run verify:release && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.cf:sandbox:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply qwen-image-3-sandbox --remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.cf:sandbox:catalog: wrangler d1 execute qwen-image-3-sandbox --remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --file worker/sandbox/stripe_catalog.sql
scripts.cf:sandbox:deploy: npm run verify:release && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.cf:pages:deploy: npm run check:worker && npm run cf:pages:bundle && wrangler pages deploy
scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run cf:migrate:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && npm run check:worker && npm run lint
